title: arequipa × mirabilis
intro: Arequipa × mirabilis, commonly known as the hybrid of Arequipa and Mirabilis jalapa, is a plant species native to South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Arequipa × mirabilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and potential antiviral properties, making it a subject of interest in the field of pharmacology.
